dedupe_keys.name: ref lists of french amateur radio repeaters and beacons

description: The Réseau des Émetteurs Français, the national amateur radio association of France, publishes two online lists. The list of repeaters is an interactive table of the call signs of repeater stations assigned by the French frequency agency ANFR under the responsibility of an authorised radio amateur; it can be filtered by beacons or repeaters, department, band from 28 MHz to 47 GHz and mode (FM, DMR, D-STAR, C4FM, APRS, ATV, Echolink, Hamnet, packet, Tetra and others), with distances from the user's locator, and it is updated once or twice a month from change forms and public sources. The list of French beacons gives, band by band, the frequency, call sign, locator, location, department, altitude, power, antenna, direction, status and responsible operator, and the version read was updated on 26 September 2026. Access is free online; no licence is stated on the pages read. Caveats: the lists depend on reports from operators and are not an official register, and they are web tables, not downloads. Coverage is France, including overseas departments. It supports analysis of backup and emergency communications that do not depend on the public telecom network, and of the space weather effects on HF and VHF propagation that beacons reveal; related records are the ÖVSV repeater and digipeater database and HamnetDB.
